title: Generalise scan_window to any bucket length (days or weeks)
description:
File: src/papyrus_content/knowledge_snapshot/trends.py (scan_window, DAYS_PER_WEEK and anything that assumes weeks; exceeds_report).
Change: take the bucket length as a parameter (default stays a week so ideas/trends.py and the knowledge snapshot are unchanged). Windows stay 1, 2, 4, 8 ... buckets, binomial tail against the corpus's own volume of the same event kind, Bonferroni-corrected. Return the window in buckets and in days.
Tests: existing trend tests unchanged and passing; new unit tests for day buckets (a burst in the last 2 days against a flat 60-day baseline is significant; the same counts spread evenly are not).
Gherkin: extend the existing trend feature with a day-bucket scenario.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
